description: Projection (RANGE-2, COL-2, COL-3, COL-6): physical values of every mandatory type, null versus absent, request order, nested columns. Core examples: hand-reviewed; their expectations are authoritative.

cases.description: FLOAT values are reported by exact bits: signed zero 80000000, quiet and signalling NaNs with payloads (7fc00001, 7f800001), negative NaN; nulls stay null.
DOUBLE by exact bits, including a NaN payload and the smallest subnormal; part 1 lacks the column, so its rows are absent, not null.
An INT32 annotated as unsigned is reported as its signed physical value: 4294967295 becomes -1, 2147483648 becomes -2147483648.
An INT64 annotated as unsigned: 18446744073709551615 is reported as -1.
COL-6: the column is literally named a.b; the dot is not a path separator.
FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY(4) values as raw bytes, including 0x00 and 0xFF bytes.
Rows from all three parts with columns f64, req, extra, i32: absent where the part lacks the column, null where the value is null; the two are never conflated.
extra exists only in part 2, req and f64 are missing from part 1: request order is kept and each row reports absent per part.
COL-7: a column no part has is absent in every row, not an error.
Requesting a is not a lookup into a.b or a nested field: it is a column no part has, so every row is absent.
key projected between other columns and twice: each occurrence carries the key's own bytes, in request order.
A STRING-annotated key projected: its physical BYTE_ARRAY bytes.
DECIMAL(30,5) stored as FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY(13): reported as the 13 bytes of the unscaled two's-complement value, not as a decimal number.
TIMESTAMP(us, UTC) reported as the physical INT64, including the INT64 extremes.
Only key is requested: unrequested annotated columns must not affect the answer.
meta is a struct. The protocol has no encoding for nested values, so the only acceptable answer is unsupported_projection; it must never be reported as absent (COL-3).
An LZ4_RAW column (ENC-1 baseline): the exact values. Unsupported, a refusal or wrong values fail.
etag requested twice: both positions carry the value (or null) in request order.
